name: pagetovid
description: Turn any web page into a narrated video from your coding agent: films the real site, writes the script, voices and captions it. Say "film this" for a free draft of the project you are working on.

interface.shortDescription: Film your project's website as a narrated video.
interface.longDescription: PageToVid opens the public page in a real browser, picks what is worth filming, writes the script, records the site, and adds an AI voice-over with captions. The film-this skill finds your project's URL, makes a free draft, offers the full render at the price your account shows, and drafts a post to share it.
defaultPrompt: Make a launch video of my site, free draft first.
Make a 9:16 video of my site for Reels.
